description: Delete a model's UNPUBLISHED eBay multi-variation draft: every variation's offer and the inventory item group are removed from eBay; the articles stay on the channel, ready for a new listing (together or one by one). A live listing is refused — end it with withdraw_ebay_variation_listing first. Refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Returns deleted. The result echoes the workspace.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: delete_ebay_variation_draft
title: Delete a model's eBay variation draft
